credit: Gustave Doré (1832–1883), engravings for La Grande Bible de Tours, 1866 · Public domain · via Wikimedia Commons

plates.title: The Creation of Light
plates.scene: God speaks light into being, and radiance breaks across the dark, formless deep.
plates.file: 001.The Creation of Light.jpg

plates.title: The Creation of Eve
plates.scene: While Adam lies in a deep sleep, the LORD God forms Eve and brings her to him.
plates.file: 002.The Creation of Eve.jpg

plates.title: Adam and Eve Are Driven out of Eden
plates.scene: Adam and Eve leave the garden while a cherub with a flaming sword guards the way behind them.
plates.file: 003.Adam and Eve Are Driven out of Eden.jpg

plates.title: Cain and Abel Offer Their Sacrifices
plates.scene: Cain and Abel offer their gifts on altars; the LORD accepts Abel's offering and not Cain's.
plates.file: 004.Cain and Abel Offer Their Sacrifices.jpg

plates.title: Cain Slays Abel
plates.scene: In the field Cain rises against his brother Abel and kills him, and Abel's blood cries out from the ground.
plates.file: 005.Cain Slays Abel.jpg

plates.title: The Great Flood
plates.scene: The last survivors cling to a rocky height as the waters rise over the highest hills.
plates.file: 007.The Great Flood.jpg

plates.title: The World Is Destroyed by Water
plates.scene: The ark rides the floodwaters while every living thing on the land perishes beneath them.
plates.file: 006.The World Is Destroyed by Water.jpg

plates.title: A Dove Is Sent Forth from the Ark
plates.scene: Noah sends a dove out from the ark over the waters to see whether they have gone down.
plates.file: 008.A Dove Is Sent Forth from the Ark.jpg

plates.title: Noah Curses Canaan
plates.scene: Noah wakes from his wine and pronounces a curse on Canaan and a blessing on Shem and Japheth.
plates.file: 009.Noah Curses Ham and Canaan.jpg

plates.title: The Tower of Babel
plates.scene: As the LORD confounds their language, the builders of the great tower in Shinar fall into confusion and despair, one man flinging his arms up toward heaven, while the work lies abandoned behind them.
plates.file: 010.The Tower of Babel.jpg

plates.title: Abraham Goes to the Land of Canaan
plates.scene: Abram sets out from Haran with Sarai, Lot, and his herds and camels toward the land of Canaan.
plates.file: 011.Abraham Goes to the Land of Canaan.jpg

plates.title: Abraham and the Three Angels
plates.scene: At Mamre, Abraham bows to the ground before three visitors and asks them to stay and rest.
plates.file: 012.Abraham and the Three Angels.jpg

plates.title: Lot Flees as Sodom and Gomorrah Burn
plates.scene: Lot and his daughters flee as fire falls on Sodom and Gomorrah, and his wife, looking back, becomes a pillar of salt.
plates.file: 013.Lot Flees as Sodom and Gomorrah Burn.jpg

plates.title: Abraham Sends Hagar and Ishmael Away
plates.scene: At Sarah's urging and with God's assurance, Abraham gives Hagar bread and water and sends her away with Ishmael.
plates.file: 014.Abraham Sends Hagar and Ishmael Away.jpg

plates.title: Hagar and Ishmael in the Wilderness
plates.scene: With the water spent and the empty bottle lying on the sand, Hagar kneels against a great rock with her arms raised over her head in grief, while Ishmael lies faint some distance away.
plates.file: 015.Hagar and Ishmael in the Wilderness.jpg

plates.title: The Testing of Abraham's Faith
plates.scene: Isaac climbs the rocky hillside with the wood for the burnt offering on his shoulders, as his father Abraham walks with him, staff in hand.
plates.file: 016.The Testing of Abraham's Faith.jpg

plates.title: The Burial of Sarah
plates.scene: Abraham buries Sarah in the cave of Machpelah near Mamre, in Hebron.
plates.file: 017.The Burial of Sarah.jpg

plates.title: Eliezer and Rebekah at the Well
plates.scene: At the well, Rebekah lowers her jar to give Abraham's servant a drink and then draws water for his camels.
plates.file: 018.Eliezer and Rebekah at the Well.jpg

plates.title: Rebekah Sets Out to Meet Isaac
plates.scene: Rebekah sets out on a canopied camel with Abraham's servant and her maids, while her family at the town gate lift their hands in farewell and weep to see her go.
plates.file: 019.The Meeting of Isaac and Rebekah.jpg

plates.title: Isaac Blesses Jacob
plates.scene: Blind and aged, Isaac feels Jacob's disguised hands and gives him the blessing meant for the firstborn.
plates.file: 020.Isaac Blesses Jacob.jpg

plates.title: Jacob's Dream
plates.scene: Sleeping with a stone for a pillow, Jacob dreams of a stairway to heaven with angels going up and down it.
plates.file: 021.Jacob's Dream.jpg

plates.title: Jacob Tends Laban's Flocks and Meets Rachel
plates.scene: At the well near Haran, Rachel stands with her water jar on her shoulder while Jacob, shepherd's staff in hand, sits watching over Laban's flock.
plates.file: 022.Jacob Tends Laban's Flocks and Meets Rachel.jpg

plates.title: Jacob Prays for Protection
plates.scene: Afraid of meeting Esau, Jacob humbly prays to the God of Abraham and Isaac for deliverance.
plates.file: 023.Jacob Prays for Protection.jpg

plates.title: Jacob Wrestles with the Angel
plates.scene: Left alone at night by the Jabbok, Jacob wrestles until daybreak and receives a blessing and the name Israel.
plates.file: 024.Jacob Wrestles with the Angel.jpg

plates.title: Jacob and Esau Meet
plates.scene: Jacob bows seven times as he approaches, and Esau runs to embrace and kiss him, and they weep together.
plates.file: 025.Jacob and Esau Meet.jpg

plates.title: Joseph Is Sold by His Brothers
plates.scene: Joseph's brothers draw him up from the pit and sell him to a passing caravan of merchants bound for Egypt.
plates.file: 026.Joseph Is Sold by His Brothers.jpg

plates.title: Joseph Interprets Pharaoh's Dream
plates.scene: Standing before the enthroned Pharaoh, Joseph explains that God has revealed seven years of plenty followed by seven years of famine.
plates.file: 027.Joseph Interprets Pharaoh's Dream.jpg

plates.title: Joseph Reveals Himself to His Brothers
plates.scene: Joseph sends out his attendants and, weeping, makes himself known to his astonished and fearful brothers.
plates.file: 028.Joseph Reveals Himself to His Brothers.jpg

plates.title: Jacob Goes to Egypt
plates.scene: The aged Jacob sets out for Egypt with his household, their flocks and their water jars; Doré shows him riding high on a camel, where Genesis tells of the wagons Pharaoh sent to carry him.
plates.file: 029.Jacob Goes to Egypt.jpg

plates.title: The Child Moses on the Nile
plates.scene: The infant Moses lies in his ark of bulrushes, drifting among the reeds of the moonlit Nile, while angels hover above and keep watch over him.
plates.file: 030.The Child Moses on the Nile.jpg

plates.title: The Finding of Moses
plates.scene: Pharaoh's daughter and her maidens find the Hebrew infant in his basket among the reeds and are moved with compassion.
plates.file: 031.The Finding of Moses.jpg

plates.title: Moses and Aaron Appear before Pharaoh
plates.scene: Moses and Aaron stand before Pharaoh's throne to deliver God's command, and Aaron casts down his rod as a sign.
plates.file: 032.Moses and Aaron Appear before Pharaoh.jpg

plates.title: The Fifth Plague: Livestock Disease
plates.scene: A grievous pestilence strikes down the livestock of Egypt in the fields, while the cattle of Israel are spared.
plates.file: 033.The Fifth Plague. Livestock Disease.jpg

plates.title: The Ninth Plague: Darkness
plates.scene: A thick darkness that can be felt covers Egypt for three days, though the Israelites have light in their dwellings.
plates.file: 034.The Ninth Plague. Darkness.jpg

plates.title: The Firstborn of the Egyptians Are Slain
plates.scene: At midnight the firstborn of Egypt die, and a great cry of mourning rises from every Egyptian household.
plates.file: 035.The Firstborn of the Egyptians Are Slain.jpg

plates.title: The Egyptians Ask Moses to Depart
plates.scene: After the death of the firstborn, Pharaoh and the Egyptians urge Moses and Aaron to lead Israel out of Egypt in haste.
plates.file: 036.The Egyptians Ask Moses to Depart.jpg

plates.title: The Egyptians Drown in the Sea
plates.scene: As Moses stretches his hand over the sea, the waters return and overwhelm Pharaoh's chariots and horsemen.
plates.file: 037.The Egyptians Drown in the Sea.jpg

plates.title: The Giving of the Law on Mount Sinai
plates.scene: At the foot of Mount Sinai the people fall on their faces and lift their hands in awe as cloud and light rest on the mountain where the LORD has come down.
plates.file: 038.The Giving of the Law on Mount Sinai.jpg

plates.title: Moses Breaks the Tables of the Law
plates.scene: Seeing the golden calf and the dancing, Moses in anger casts down the tablets of the Law and breaks them at the foot of the mountain.
plates.file: 041A.Moses Breaks the Tables of the Law.jpg

plates.title: Moses Comes Down from Mount Sinai
plates.scene: Moses comes down from Mount Sinai carrying the two tablets of the testimony, his face shining from having spoken with God.
plates.file: 039.Moses Comes Down from Mount Sinai.jpg

plates.title: The Spies Return from the Promised Land
plates.scene: The spies return from Canaan with a great cluster of grapes carried on a pole between two men, showing the fruit of the land.
plates.file: 041B.The Spies Return from the Promised Land.jpg

plates.title: The Death of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram
plates.scene: The ground splits open beneath Korah, Dathan, and Abiram and their households, and fire from the LORD consumes the 250 men offering incense.
plates.file: 040.The Death of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.jpg

plates.title: Moses Strikes the Rock
plates.scene: Water streams from the rock Moses has struck, and the thirsty people crowd its banks to drink with their children and animals, as Moses stands above with his rod raised.
plates.file: 041.Moses Strikes the Rock at Horeb.jpg

plates.title: The Bronze Serpent
plates.scene: Afflicted by fiery serpents, the Israelites look to the bronze serpent Moses has set on a pole and are healed.
plates.file: 042.The Bronze Serpent.jpg

plates.title: An Angel Appears to Balaam
plates.scene: The angel of the LORD, sword drawn, stands in Balaam's path, and his donkey turns aside and falls down as Balaam strikes her.
plates.file: 043.An Angel Appears to Balaam.jpg

plates.title: The Israelites Cross the Jordan River
plates.scene: The armed men of Israel, with camels and riders, file across the bed of the Jordan toward the far bank, where the host of Israel already stretches to the horizon.
plates.file: 044. The Israelites Cross the Jordan River.jpg

plates.title: An Angel Appears to the Israelites
plates.scene: Near Jericho an angel stands on a height before the assembled host of Israel, one arm raised toward heaven, as many in the camp kneel and bow to the ground.
plates.file: 045. An Angel Appears to the Israelites.jpg

plates.title: The Walls of Jericho Fall Down
plates.scene: On the seventh day, at the priests' trumpet blast and the people's great shout, the walls of Jericho fall down flat.
plates.file: 046.The Walls of Jericho Fall Down.jpg

plates.title: Joshua Spares Rahab
plates.scene: At Joshua's command the two spies bring Rahab and her family safely out of Jericho, keeping the oath made to her.
plates.file: 047.Joshua Spares Rahab.jpg

plates.title: Achan Is Stoned to Death
plates.scene: In the valley of Achor, Achan, who took forbidden spoil from Jericho, is stoned by Israel and a heap of stones is raised over him.
plates.file: 048.Achan Is Stoned to Death.jpg

plates.title: Joshua Burns the Town of Ai
plates.scene: Flames and smoke rise over the city of Ai as Joshua's forces take it and lay it waste.
plates.file: 049.Joshua Burns the Town of Ai.jpg

plates.title: The Army of the Amorites Is Destroyed
plates.scene: The fleeing Amorite host is struck down on the descent of Beth-horon by great hailstones from heaven.
plates.file: 050.The Army of the Amorites Is Destroyed.jpg

plates.title: Joshua Commands the Sun to Stand Still
plates.scene: Joshua lifts his arm and calls on the sun to stand still over Gibeon and the moon over the valley of Ajalon.
plates.file: 051.Joshua Commands the Sun to Stand Still.jpg

plates.title: Jael Kills Sisera
plates.scene: Jael draws back the curtain of her tent to show Barak and his pursuing soldiers the man they seek: Sisera lying dead on the floor, slain with a tent peg.
plates.file: 052.Jael Kills Sisera.jpg

plates.title: Deborah Praises Jael
plates.scene: Deborah raises her song of victory to the LORD, blessing Jael above women.
plates.file: 053.Deborah Praises Jael.jpg

plates.title: Gideon Chooses 300 Soldiers
plates.scene: At the water of Harod, Gideon watches how his men drink and keeps the three hundred who lap from their hands.
plates.file: 054.Gideon Chooses 300 Soldiers.jpg

plates.title: The Midianites Are Routed
plates.scene: In the night the Midianite camp falls into panic and flight as Gideon's men sound trumpets and break their pitchers.
plates.file: 055.The Midianites Are Routed.jpg

plates.title: The Death of Gideon's Sons
plates.scene: At dusk the slain sons of Gideon lie heaped upon the ground as Abimelech's armed band marches away along the horizon.
plates.file: 056.The Death of Gideon's Sons.jpg

plates.title: The Death of Abimelech
plates.scene: Beneath the tower of Thebez, Abimelech lies bleeding beside the millstone a woman cast down on his head, as his soldiers gather over him.
plates.file: 057.The Death of Abimelech.jpg

plates.title: Jephthah's Daughter Comes to Meet Her Father
plates.scene: Jephthah's only daughter comes out to meet her returning father, dancing with arms flung wide as her companions play timbrels, cymbals, harp and trumpet.
plates.file: 058.Jephthah's Daughter Comes to Meet Her Father.jpg

plates.title: Israelite Women Mourn with Jephthah's Daughter
plates.scene: Jephthah's daughter and her companions go up into the mountains to mourn for two months.
plates.file: 059.Israelite Women Mourn with Jephthah's Daughter.jpg

plates.title: Samson Slays a Lion
plates.scene: On the way down to Timnath, with the Spirit of the LORD upon him, Samson grapples a roaring young lion among the rocks and tears it apart with his bare hands.
plates.file: 060.Samson Slays a Lion.jpg

plates.title: Samson Destroys the Philistines with an Ass' Jawbone
plates.scene: At Lehi, freed from his bonds, Samson strikes down the Philistines with the jawbone of an ass.
plates.file: 061.Samson Destroys the Philistines with an Ass' Jawbone.jpg

plates.title: Samson Carries away the Gates of Gaza
plates.scene: At midnight Samson lifts the doors and posts of Gaza's city gate onto his shoulders and carries them toward the hill before Hebron.
plates.file: 062.Samson Carries away the Gates of Gaza.jpg

plates.title: Samson and Delilah
plates.scene: Seated on a couch, Samson lifts a lock of his uncut hair as he tells Delilah all his heart, while she stands beside him with her eyes cast down.
plates.file: 063.Samson and Delilah.jpg

plates.title: The Death of Samson
plates.scene: Blind Samson prays for strength one last time, then bows between the pillars and brings the house down on the Philistine lords.
plates.file: 064.The Death of Samson.jpg

plates.title: A Levite Finds a Woman's Corpse
plates.scene: At dawn the Levite opens the door and finds his concubine fallen at the threshold after the night's violence.
plates.file: 065.A Levite Finds a Woman's Corpse.jpg

plates.title: The Levite Carries the Woman's Body Away
plates.scene: Getting no answer, the Levite lays the woman's body on his donkey and sets out for home.
plates.file: 066.The Levite Carries the Woman's Body Away.jpg

plates.title: The Benjaminites Seize the Daughters of Shiloh
plates.scene: Benjaminite men rush out of the vineyards to seize wives from the maidens dancing at the feast in Shiloh.
plates.file: 067.The Benjaminites Take the Virgins of Jabesh-gilead.jpg

plates.title: Naomi and Her Daughters-in-Law
plates.scene: On the road from Moab, Orpah kisses Naomi and turns back while Ruth clings to her and vows to go with her.
plates.file: 068.Naomi and Her Daughters-in-Law.jpg

plates.title: Ruth and Boaz
plates.scene: In the harvest field Boaz notices Ruth gleaning among the reapers and speaks kindly to her.
plates.file: 069.Ruth and Boaz.jpg

plates.title: The Ark Is Returned to Beth-shemesh
plates.scene: Two lowing cows draw the cart carrying the ark toward Beth-shemesh, and the reapers in the wheat harvest look up and rejoice.
plates.file: 070.The Ark Is Returned to Beth-shemesh.jpg

plates.title: Samuel Blesses Saul
plates.scene: On the hilltop the young Saul kneels before the aged Samuel, who grips his staff and lifts his face and open hand toward heaven in blessing.
plates.file: 070A.Samuel Blesses Saul.jpg

plates.title: The Death of Agag
plates.scene: At Gilgal, Samuel carries out judgment before the LORD on Agag, king of the Amalekites.
plates.file: 071.The Death of Agag.jpg

plates.title: David Slays Goliath
plates.scene: Standing on the fallen giant beside his great sword, David holds Goliath's severed head aloft as the Israelites cheer and the Philistines flee.
plates.file: 071A.David Slays Goliath.jpg

plates.title: Saul Attempts to Kill David
plates.scene: As David plays the harp, King Saul, troubled by an evil spirit, hurls his javelin at him.
plates.file: 072.Saul Attempts to Kill David.jpg

plates.title: David Escapes through a Window
plates.scene: Michal lets David down through a window by night so he can escape the men Saul sent to kill him.
plates.file: 073.David Escapes through a Window.jpg

plates.title: David and Jonathan
plates.scene: David and Jonathan embrace and weep as they part, bound by their oath before the LORD.
plates.file: 073A.David and Jonathan.jpg

plates.title: David Shows Saul How He Spared His Life
plates.scene: Outside the cave at En-gedi, David stands on a rock and holds up the piece of Saul's robe toward the king and his men on the cliff above.
plates.file: 074.David Shows Saul How He Spared His Life.jpg

plates.title: Saul and the Witch of Endor
plates.scene: At Endor the woman cries out as the form of Samuel rises, and Saul bows with his face to the ground.
plates.file: 075.Saul and the Witch of Endor.jpg

plates.title: The Death of Saul
plates.scene: Badly wounded on Mount Gilboa, Saul falls upon his own sword, and his armour-bearer dies beside him.
plates.file: 076.The Death of Saul.jpg

plates.title: Jabesh-Gileadites Recover the Bodies of Saul and His Sons
plates.scene: The valiant men of Jabesh-gilead travel all night to take the bodies of Saul and his sons down from the wall of Beth-shan.
plates.file: 077.Jabesh-Gileadites Recover the Bodies of Saul and His Sons.jpg

plates.title: Combat between Soldiers of Ish-bosheth and David
plates.scene: Twelve young men from Ish-bosheth's side and twelve of David's grapple at the pool of Gibeon and fall together.
plates.file: 078.Combat between Soldiers of Ish-bosheth and David.jpg

plates.title: David Attacks the Ammonites
plates.scene: Before the walls of conquered Rabbah, the Ammonite captives lie cast down on the ground as iron-bladed chariots are driven over them. Doré follows the Latin reading of 12:31; the KJV reads “harrows of iron”, and the BSB says David put them to work with iron tools.
plates.file: 079.David Attacks the Ammonites.jpg

plates.title: The Death of Absalom
plates.scene: Absalom hangs caught in the boughs of a great oak as Joab thrusts three darts into his heart.
plates.file: 080.The Death of Absalom.jpg

plates.title: David Mourns the Death of Absalom
plates.scene: In the chamber over the gate, King David weeps for his son, crying out for Absalom.
plates.file: 081.David Mourns the Death of Absalom.jpg

plates.title: Rizpah’s Kindness toward the Dead
plates.scene: Rizpah spreads sackcloth on the rock and guards the bodies of the hanged men, two of them her own sons, from birds by day and beasts by night.
plates.file: 082.Rizpah’s Kindness toward the Dead.jpg

plates.title: Abishai Saves David's Life
plates.scene: When David grows faint in battle, Abishai rushes to his aid and strikes down the giant Ishbi-benob.
plates.file: 083.Abishai Saves David's Life.jpg

plates.title: The Judgment of Solomon
plates.scene: Solomon orders the living child divided with a sword, and the true mother pleads for the baby's life.
plates.file: 084.The Judgment of Solomon.jpg

plates.title: King Solomon in Old Age
plates.scene: The aged King Solomon, crowned and white-bearded, sits in thought with a pen in one hand and a written scroll in the other, surrounded by the writings of the wisdom God gave him.
plates.file: 087.King Solomon in Old Age.jpg

plates.title: Cedars Are Cut Down for the Jerusalem Temple
plates.scene: Workmen fell the great cedars of Lebanon for the house Solomon will build to the name of the LORD.
plates.file: 085.Cedars Are Cut Down for the Jerusalem Temple.jpg

plates.title: Solomon Receives the Queen of Sheba
plates.scene: In Solomon's pillared hall the king stands by his throne and stretches out his hand in welcome as the queen of Sheba, her train borne by pages, approaches with attendants bearing gifts.
plates.file: 086.Solomon Receives the Queen of Sheba.jpg

plates.title: The Disobedient Prophet Is Slain by a Lion
plates.scene: The disobedient man of God lies dead in the road, with the lion and his donkey standing quietly beside the body.
plates.file: 088.The Disobedient Prophet Is Slain by a Lion.jpg

plates.title: Elijah Raises the Son of the Widow of Zarephath
plates.scene: Elijah cries to the LORD over the widow's son, who revives, and he gives the boy back to his mother alive.
plates.file: 089.Elijah Raises the Son of the Widow of Zarephath.jpg

plates.title: The Prophets of Baal Are Slaughtered
plates.scene: At Elijah's command the people seize the prophets of Baal and they are slain at the brook Kishon.
plates.file: 090.The Prophets of Baal Are Slaughtered.jpg

plates.title: Elijah Is Nourished by an Angel
plates.scene: Sitting beneath the juniper tree, Elijah looks up as an angel comes down to him with a jar of water and bread, bidding him arise and eat.
plates.file: 091.Elijah Is Nourished by an Angel.jpg

plates.title: The Israelites Slaughter the Syrians
plates.scene: Israel's chariots and spearmen drive through the fallen Syrian host at Aphek, the walled city rising on the hill behind.
plates.file: 092.The Israelites Slaughter the Syrians.jpg

plates.title: The Death of Ahab
plates.scene: Struck by an arrow shot at random, King Ahab is held up in his chariot as the battle rages, and he dies at evening.
plates.file: 093.The Death of Ahab.jpg

plates.title: Elijah Destroys the Messengers of Ahaziah
plates.scene: From a hilltop Elijah calls down fire from heaven, which consumes the captains and soldiers King Ahaziah sent to seize him.
plates.file: 094.Elijah Destroys the Messengers of Ahaziah.jpg

plates.title: Elijah Ascends to Heaven in a Chariot of Fire
plates.scene: A chariot and horses of fire part Elijah from Elisha as the prophet is taken up by a whirlwind into heaven.
plates.file: 095.Elijah Ascends to Heaven in a Chariot of Fire.jpg

plates.title: Some Children Are Destroyed by Bears
plates.scene: After youths from Bethel jeer at Elisha on the road, two she-bears come out of the wood upon them.
plates.file: 095.Some Children Are Destroyed by Bears.jpg

plates.title: A Famine in Samaria
plates.scene: During the Syrian siege, the king of Israel stands on the city wall above starving people as a woman cries out to him for help.
plates.file: 096.A Famine in Samaria.jpg

plates.title: The Death of Jezebel
plates.scene: At Jehu's command, the painted queen Jezebel is thrown down from her window at Jezreel.
plates.file: 097.The Death of Jezebel.jpg

plates.title: Jehu's Companions Find Jezebel's Remains
plates.scene: Jehu's men come to bury Jezebel and find only her skull, feet and hands, fulfilling Elijah's word.
plates.file: 098.Jehu's Companions Find Jezebel's Remains.jpg

plates.title: The Death of Athaliah
plates.scene: Athaliah, crying 'Treason', is seized by the captains at Jehoiada's order and put to death outside the temple.
plates.file: 099.The Death of Athaliah.jpg

plates.title: Foreign Nations Are Slain by Lions in Samaria
plates.scene: The foreign peoples settled in Samaria by the Assyrian king are attacked by lions sent among them because they did not fear the LORD.
plates.file: 100.Foreign Nations Are Slain by Lions in Samaria.jpg

plates.title: Sennacherib's Army Is Destroyed
plates.scene: In the night the angel of the LORD strides sword in hand through the Assyrian camp beneath a lightning-torn sky, and Sennacherib's warriors and horses fall on every side.
plates.file: 101.Sennacherib's Army Is Destroyed.jpg

plates.title: Zedekiah's Sons Are Slaughtered before His Eyes
plates.scene: At Riblah the captured King Zedekiah is made to watch his sons put to death before he is blinded and bound.
plates.file: 102.Zedekiah's Sons Are Slaughtered before His Eyes.jpg

plates.title: The Plague of Jerusalem
plates.scene: As the plague sweeps through Jerusalem, a robed elder stands with both arms lifted to heaven in intercession while the dying and the grieving lie around him.
plates.file: 102A.The Plague of Jerusalem.jpg

plates.title: The Ammonite and Moabite Armies Are Destroyed
plates.scene: As Judah sings praise, the armies of Ammon, Moab and Mount Seir turn on one another and fall in the wilderness.
plates.file: 103.The Ammonite and Moabite Armies Are Destroyed.jpg

plates.title: Cyrus Restores the Vessels of the Temple
plates.scene: Cyrus king of Persia brings out the temple vessels Nebuchadnezzar had carried off and hands them over to Sheshbazzar for Jerusalem.
plates.file: 104.Cyrus Restores the Vessels of the Temple.jpg

plates.title: The Rebuilding of the Temple Is Begun
plates.scene: Returned exiles haul and set great stones for the house of the LORD while a leader lifts his hands in praise over the work.
plates.file: 105.The Rebuilding of the Temple Is Begun.jpg

plates.title: Artaxerxes Grants Freedom to the Jews
plates.scene: Before a Persian palace, King Artaxerxes' decree lets any of Israel who are willing go up to Jerusalem with Ezra.
plates.file: 106.Artaxerxes Grants Freedom to the Jews.jpg

plates.title: Ezra Kneels in Prayer
plates.scene: At the evening sacrifice Ezra, his garments torn, sinks down on the stone terrace with his head bowed low in grief and confession for the people, while the assembly gathers behind him.
plates.file: 107.Ezra Kneels in Prayer.jpg

plates.title: Nehemiah Views the Ruins of Jerusalem's Walls
plates.scene: Nehemiah rides out by night with a few companions to survey Jerusalem's broken walls and burned gates.
plates.file: 108.Nehemiah Views the Ruins of Jerusalem's Walls.jpg

plates.title: Ezra Reads the Law to the People
plates.scene: Standing on raised stone steps, Ezra holds up a tablet inscribed with the law and points to its words as he reads it aloud to the people gathered around and below him.
plates.file: 109.Ezra Reads the Law to the People.jpg

plates.title: Queen Vashti Refuses to Obey Ahasuerus' Command
plates.scene: Queen Vashti refuses the king's summons to appear at his feast, and Ahasuerus is filled with anger.
plates.file: 114.Queen Vashti Refuses to Obey Ahasuerus' Command.jpg

plates.title: Esther Before the King
plates.scene: Esther, in royal robes, comes unbidden into the king's inner court and, as in the Greek additions to Esther that Doré followed, sinks fainting into the arms of her maids, while Ahasuerus stands before his canopied throne.
plates.file: 115.Esther Before the King.jpg

plates.title: The Triumph of Mordecai
plates.scene: Haman leads Mordecai through the city on the king's horse in royal apparel, proclaiming the honor the king has given him.
plates.file: 116.The Triumph of Mordecai.jpg

plates.title: Esther Accuses Haman
plates.scene: At her banquet Esther pleads for her people and names Haman to the king as their enemy.
plates.file: 117.Esther Accuses Haman.jpg

plates.title: Job Hears of His Misfortunes
plates.scene: Messengers arrive one after another with news of Job's losses, one pointing back toward the burning fields, and Job stands stricken in his doorway with his hand pressed to his head while the women of his house fall to the ground in grief.
plates.file: 118.Job Hears of His Misfortunes.jpg

plates.title: Job Speaks with His Friends
plates.scene: Seated on a heap of straw in his affliction, Job lifts his arm toward heaven as he speaks, while Eliphaz, Bildad and Zophar stand and sit close beside him, one resting his chin on his hand as he listens.
plates.file: 119.Job Speaks with His Friends.jpg

plates.title: The Prophet Isaiah
plates.scene: The prophet Isaiah sits in quiet contemplation on a rock above a wide landscape, receiving the vision concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
plates.file: 120.The Prophet Isaiah.jpg

plates.title: Isaiah's Vision of the Destruction of Babylon
plates.scene: Isaiah's vision of fallen Babylon, its palaces and theaters in ruins and left to birds and wild creatures.
plates.file: 121.Isaiah's Vision of the Destruction of Babylon.jpg

plates.title: The Destruction of Leviathan
plates.scene: The LORD, with His great and strong sword, slays Leviathan, the twisting serpent of the sea.
plates.file: 122.The Destruction of Leviathan.jpg

plates.title: The Prophet Jeremiah
plates.scene: Under a storm-dark sky, Jeremiah sinks back against the stone steps, face lifted and one arm flung toward heaven, as he cries out the LORD's warning of disaster from the north, while listeners sit about him in sorrow.
plates.file: 123.The Prophet Jeremiah.jpg

plates.title: Baruch Writes Jeremiah's Prophecies
plates.scene: Baruch kneels with a writing tablet, taking down the LORD's words as Jeremiah stands above him in a shaft of light and speaks.
plates.file: 123.Baruch Writes Jeremiah's Prophecies.jpg

plates.title: Baruch
plates.scene: Faint with sorrow, Baruch the scribe sits slumped against a sunlit stone wall beside his scrolls, one hand pressed to his bowed head.
plates.file: 125.Baruch.jpg

plates.title: People Mourn over the Destruction of Jerusalem
plates.scene: Grieving men, women and children sit and lie beneath the walls of ruined Jerusalem, mourning the city's desolation.
plates.file: 124.People Mourn over the Destruction of Jerusalem.jpg

plates.title: The Prophet Ezekiel
plates.scene: Ezekiel stands on a hillside with his staff and lifts his hand, while elders of Israel sit before him to hear the word of the LORD.
plates.file: 126.The Prophet Ezekiel.jpg

plates.title: Ezekiel’s Vision of the Valley of Dry Bones
plates.scene: Ezekiel stands above a valley full of bones as the skeletons stir and rise toward life at the word of the LORD.
plates.file: 127.Ezekiel’s Vision of the Valley of Dry Bones.jpg

plates.title: Daniel among the Exiles
plates.scene: Standing apart in thought amid the great buildings of Babylon, Daniel rests his hand on a written scroll while fellow captives from Judah walk and sit in sorrow behind him.
plates.file: 128.Daniel among the Exiles.jpg

plates.title: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Furnace
plates.scene: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego stand unharmed among the furnace flames while Nebuchadnezzar and his court look down in astonishment.
plates.file: 129.Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Furnace.jpg

plates.title: Daniel Interprets the Writing on the Wall
plates.scene: At Belshazzar's feast, Daniel points to the mysterious writing on the palace wall and declares its meaning to the king.
plates.file: 130.Daniel Interprets the Writing on the Wall.jpg

plates.title: Daniel in the Lions' Den
plates.scene: Daniel stands calmly among the lions in the den, his face turned toward the light falling from the opening above.
plates.file: 131.Daniel in the Lions' Den.jpg

plates.title: Daniel's Vision of the Four Beasts
plates.scene: In Daniel's night vision, four great and fearsome beasts rise one after another from the wind-driven sea.
plates.file: 132.Daniel's Vision of the Four Beasts.jpg

plates.title: The Prophet Amos
plates.scene: Amos, the herdsman of Tekoa, stands with his staff on a hilltop at dusk, looking out over a walled city.
plates.file: 136.The Prophet Amos.jpg

plates.title: Jonah Is Spewed Forth by the Whale
plates.scene: The great fish turns back to the sea after casting Jonah onto the rocky shore, where he scrambles up out of the surf.
plates.file: 137.Jonah Is Spewed Forth by the Whale.jpg

plates.title: Jonah Preaches to the Ninevites
plates.scene: Jonah stands on a raised platform in Nineveh proclaiming the city's coming overthrow, while its people kneel and bow in repentance around him.
plates.file: 138.Jonah Preaches to the Ninevites.jpg

plates.title: Micah Exhorts the Israelites to Repent
plates.scene: Micah raises both arms as he pleads with the people of Israel to return to the LORD, some of them bowing to the ground in sorrow.
plates.file: 139.Micah Exhorts the Israelites to Repent.jpg

plates.title: Zechariah's Vision of Four Chariots
plates.scene: Zechariah sees four chariots with horses of different colours come out from between two mountains of brass.
plates.file: 140.Zechariah's Vision of Four Chariots.jpg

plates.title: The Wise Men Guided by the Star
plates.scene: The wise men's caravan of camels and attendants travels through the night, following the star they saw in the east.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89474948).jpg

plates.title: The Flight Into Egypt
plates.scene: Joseph leads the donkey carrying Mary and the young child Jesus across the desert as they flee into Egypt.
plates.file: Nowy Testament Pana naszego Jezusa Chrystusa 1892 (94130811).jpg

plates.title: The Massacre of the Innocents
plates.scene: Herod's soldiers carry out his cruel order in Bethlehem while mothers struggle to shield their little children.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89475211).jpg

plates.title: Jesus Healing the Sick
plates.scene: Kneeling on the steps of a colonnaded building, Jesus lays his hand on a limp child held in a woman's arms, as the sick, the lame and the suffering are brought to him and grave onlookers watch.
plates.file: Jesus healing the sick (89476181).jpg

plates.title: Jesus Preaching to the Multitude
plates.scene: Seated beneath a great tree, Jesus raises his hand toward heaven as he preaches the gospel of the kingdom to the people gathered about him, some standing and some kneeling with bowed heads.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89475971).jpg

plates.title: The Sermon on the Mount
plates.scene: Jesus sits on the mountainside and teaches the gathered multitude the Beatitudes.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89476389).jpg

plates.title: The Dumb Man Possessed
plates.scene: A man possessed and unable to speak kneels at Jesus' side and reaches up to him, while the people look on and a group of Pharisees confer among themselves.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89476500).jpg

plates.title: Christ in the Synagogue
plates.scene: Jesus teaches in the synagogue of his home town while the listeners question where he gained such wisdom.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89480773).jpg

plates.title: The Daughter of Herodias Receiving the Head of John the Baptist
plates.scene: The daughter of Herodias receives the head of John the Baptist on a charger, as she had asked of Herod.
plates.file: The Bible panorama, or The Holy Scriptures in picture and story (1891) (14598300480).jpg

plates.title: Christ Feeding the Multitude
plates.scene: In the wilderness, the disciples carry baskets of bread and fishes among the great multitude seated on the ground, handing food even to the little children, while Jesus stands in the distance.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89476956).jpg

plates.title: The Transfiguration
plates.scene: On the high mountain Jesus shines in glory between Moses and Elijah, while Peter, James and John fall to the ground in awe.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89477161).jpg

plates.title: Jesus Healing the Lunatic
plates.scene: A father brings his afflicted son before Jesus after the disciples could not help, and Jesus rebukes the spirit and heals the boy.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89477370).jpg

plates.title: Entry of Jesus Into Jerusalem
plates.scene: Jesus rides into Jerusalem on a colt as crowds spread garments and branches in the way, crying Hosanna.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89477540).jpg

plates.title: Christ and the Tribute Money
plates.scene: Shown a Roman coin by those seeking to trap him, Jesus asks whose image it bears and answers, “Render therefore unto Cæsar the things which are Cæsar’s; and unto God the things that are God’s.”
plates.file: Dispute of Jesus and the Pharisees (89477737).jpg

plates.title: Jesus Praying in the Garden
plates.scene: Jesus prays alone in Gethsemane that the cup might pass, then finds his disciples asleep and urges them to watch and pray.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89478813).jpg

plates.title: Jesus Scourged
plates.scene: After Pilate releases Barabbas, Jesus is bound and scourged by the soldiers before being handed over to be crucified.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89483694).jpg

plates.title: Christ Mocked
plates.scene: Robed and crowned with thorns, Jesus is mocked by kneeling soldiers who spit on him and strike his head with a reed.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89478982).jpg

plates.title: The Arrival at Calvary
plates.scene: Arriving at Golgotha, Jesus has fallen beneath the cross, as Christian tradition pictures him; two men heave its weight from him as a mounted officer looks on, a grieving woman sinks down at his side, and soldiers and the crowd press on toward the place of a skull.
plates.file: Nowy Testament Pana naszego Jezusa Chrystusa 1892 (94131731).jpg

plates.title: The Erection of the Cross
plates.scene: Soldiers haul upright the cross bearing Jesus while others cast lots for his garments and the title is set above his head.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89484283).jpg

plates.title: The Descent From the Cross
plates.scene: Joseph of Arimathea, granted the body by Pilate, lowers Jesus from the cross with the help of mourning disciples.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89484429).jpg

plates.title: The Dead Christ
plates.scene: The lifeless body of Jesus lies on a linen shroud while his followers keep watch before burial; as Christian tradition pictures the scene, his grieving mother is among them.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89484501).jpg

plates.title: The Burial of Christ
plates.scene: The body of Jesus is carried into Joseph's new rock-hewn tomb as Mary Magdalene and the other Mary look on.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89484603).jpg

plates.title: The Resurrection
plates.scene: At dawn the women come down to the opened tomb, where an angel seated on the stone points heavenward and tells them that Jesus is risen.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89479571).jpg

plates.title: John the Baptist Preaching in the Wilderness
plates.scene: Clothed in camel's hair, John the Baptist stands above the gathered crowd and points heavenward as he proclaims that one mightier than he is coming.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89475438).jpg

plates.title: The Baptism of Jesus
plates.scene: Jesus stands in the Jordan as John baptizes him, and the Spirit descends like a dove in a stream of light from the opened heavens.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89475624).jpg

plates.title: The Disciples Plucking Corn on the Sabbath
plates.scene: Walking through the grain fields on the Sabbath, the disciples pluck ears of corn as the Pharisees question Jesus.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89476651).jpg

plates.title: Jesus Stilling the Tempest
plates.scene: As a great storm swamps the boat, Jesus sleeps at the stern while the terrified disciples cry out to him.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89479109).jpg

plates.title: Jesus Blessing the Little Children
plates.scene: Jesus welcomes the little children brought to him, over the disciples' objection, and blesses them.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89479213).jpg

plates.title: The Widow's Mite
plates.scene: Watching at the temple treasury, Jesus points out the poor widow whose two small coins outweigh all the gifts of the rich.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89479480).jpg

plates.title: The Last Supper
plates.scene: At the Passover table Jesus sits among the twelve with the bread and the cup before him, one hand raised as he speaks, while the disciples listen, some troubled and questioning among themselves.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89478051).jpg

plates.title: The Judas Kiss
plates.scene: Judas arrives with an armed crowd bearing torches and betrays Jesus with a kiss, and they seize him.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89478636).jpg

plates.title: Jesus Falling Beneath the Cross
plates.scene: As Christian tradition pictures it, Jesus sinks beneath the weight of the cross on the road to Golgotha, and Simon of Cyrene is compelled to carry it.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89482940).jpg

plates.title: The Ascension
plates.scene: While the apostles watch from the hillside, some pointing and some gazing upward, the risen Christ is taken up alone into heaven in radiant light.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89479729).jpg

plates.title: The Annunciation
plates.scene: The angel Gabriel appears to Mary and greets her with the news that she will bear the Son of the Highest.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89480043).jpg

plates.title: The Nativity
plates.scene: Shepherds crowd into the stable at Bethlehem and kneel in wonder before the newborn Jesus, who lies in the manger beside Mary and Joseph.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89480279).jpg

plates.title: Jesus With the Doctors
plates.scene: The twelve-year-old Jesus stands among the teachers in the temple, listening and asking questions while they marvel at his understanding.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89480558).jpg

plates.title: The Temptation of Jesus
plates.scene: On a high mountain the devil kneels and gestures toward the kingdoms of the world, while Jesus stands firm and refuses to worship him.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89475772).jpg

plates.title: Jesus Preaching at the Sea of Galilee
plates.scene: Seated in Simon's boat just off the shore, Jesus teaches the crowd gathered at the water's edge.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89481200).jpg

plates.title: The Miraculous Draught of Fishes
plates.scene: At Jesus' word the fishermen let down their nets again and haul in so great a multitude of fish that the net begins to break, as Jesus stands by with his hand outstretched.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89480971).jpg

plates.title: Mary Magdalene Repentant
plates.scene: Alone in a desolate ravine, Mary Magdalene kneels at a rock bearing a skull and lifts her eyes in penitent prayer, as later Christian tradition pictured the woman from whom seven devils had gone out.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89481384).jpg

plates.title: Jesus Raising Up the Daughter of Jairus
plates.scene: In the quiet room Jesus stands at the bedside and lays his hand on the brow of Jairus's daughter as she lies on her bed, while her mother kneels with her head bowed against it and three men look on from across the room.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89481515).jpg

plates.title: The Good Samaritan
plates.scene: Moved with compassion, the Samaritan stops on the lonely road and lifts the man left half dead by robbers onto his own horse.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89481635).jpg

plates.title: Arrival of the Good Samaritan at the Inn
plates.scene: The Samaritan brings the wounded traveler on his own beast to the inn and entrusts him to the innkeeper's care.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89481730).jpg

plates.title: Jesus at the House of Martha and Mary
plates.scene: In Martha's house, Mary sits at Jesus' feet listening to his word while Martha, busy with serving, appeals to him.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89481903).jpg

plates.title: The Return of the Prodigal Son
plates.scene: Ragged and weary, the prodigal son reaches his father's house and leans his bowed head on his arm against a stone pillar at the top of the steps, while beneath the vine-covered arbor the household sits in sorrow and two women on the balcony gaze out into the distance.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89482051).jpg

plates.title: The Prodigal Son in the Arms of His Father
plates.scene: The father runs to meet his returning son and embraces him as the son confesses his unworthiness.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89482272).jpg

plates.title: Lazarus at the Rich Man's House
plates.scene: While the rich man's feast goes on above, his servants drive the sore-covered beggar Lazarus down the palace steps with a raised switch, and the dogs gather around him.
plates.file: Lazarus and the Rich Man (89482442).jpg

plates.title: The Pharisee and the Publican
plates.scene: In the temple the proud Pharisee stands erect with his eyes raised, while the publican lies prostrate on the floor pleading for mercy, and Jesus, who tells the parable, appears with his disciples in the bright doorway.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89482647).jpg

plates.title: The Agony in the Garden
plates.scene: Kneeling in anguished prayer on the Mount of Olives, Jesus is strengthened by an angel from heaven as his sweat falls like drops of blood.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89482762).jpg

plates.title: The Crucifixion
plates.scene: Jesus hangs on the cross between the two criminals as a shaft of light breaks through the storm clouds, while the grieving women watch from beside the rock and mounted soldiers move below.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89479023).jpg

plates.title: The Darkness at the Crucifixion
plates.scene: Darkness covers the land from the sixth to the ninth hour as Jesus commends his spirit to the Father and the onlookers turn away in fear and grief.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89483040).jpg

plates.title: Jesus and the Disciples Going to Emmaus
plates.scene: The risen Jesus walks the road to Emmaus with two disciples who do not yet know him, and explains to them what the Scriptures say about himself.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89483147).jpg

plates.title: The Marriage in Cana
plates.scene: At the wedding feast in Cana, servants fill the great stone waterpots at Jesus' word while the guests sit at the canopied table.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89483276).jpg

plates.title: The Buyers and Sellers Driven Out of the Temple
plates.scene: Jesus, with a scourge of cords, drives the traders and money-changers out of the temple and overturns their tables.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89479335).jpg

plates.title: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria
plates.scene: Weary from his journey, Jesus sits at Jacob's well and speaks with the Samaritan woman about the living water.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89483382).jpg

plates.title: Jesus Walking on the Sea
plates.scene: Jesus walks across the storm-tossed sea toward the distant boat, calling to the frightened disciples, "It is I."
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89476805).jpg

plates.title: Jesus and the Woman Taken in Adultery
plates.scene: The accused woman crouches beside Jesus, who has written on the ground and answers her accusers, “He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.”
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89483469).jpg

plates.title: Resurrection of Lazarus
plates.scene: At the opened tomb Jesus calls with a loud voice, and Lazarus comes forth still bound in grave clothes before the astonished mourners.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89483578).jpg

plates.title: Peter Denying Christ
plates.scene: In the high priest's courtyard Peter, challenged by those around the fire, denies knowing Jesus as the cock crows.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89478925).jpg

plates.title: The Crown of Thorns
plates.scene: Soldiers press a woven crown of thorns onto Jesus' head, robe him in purple, and strike him while hailing him in mockery as King of the Jews.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89483870).jpg

plates.title: Christ Presented to the People
plates.scene: Standing beside the bound, thorn-crowned Jesus at the edge of the raised pavement, Pilate presents him to the crowd below, which cries out for his crucifixion.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89483941).jpg

plates.title: Nailing Christ to the Cross
plates.scene: At Golgotha soldiers drive the nails through Jesus' hands as he lies stretched on the cross, while behind them one of the two criminals is already being bound to his upright cross.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89484137).jpg

plates.title: The Descent of the Spirit
plates.scene: On the day of Pentecost a sound as of a rushing mighty wind fills the house, cloven tongues like fire rest on each of the kneeling believers, and they are all filled with the Holy Spirit.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89484689).jpg

plates.title: The Apostles Preaching the Gospel
plates.scene: Standing on a rocky height with his fellow apostles, Peter points heavenward as he tells the listeners gathered below that God has raised and exalted Jesus.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89484816).jpg

plates.title: Peter and John at the Beautiful Gate
plates.scene: At the temple gate called Beautiful, Peter and John take a man lame from birth by the hand and raise him to his feet in the name of Jesus.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89484920).jpg

plates.title: Death of Ananias
plates.scene: Rebuked by Peter for lying to the Holy Spirit about the price of his land, Ananias falls dead before the apostles, his coins scattered on the ground.
plates.file: DoreDeathofAnanias.jpg

plates.title: Martyrdom of Stephen
plates.scene: Driven out of the city, Stephen kneels and prays for his attackers as the crowd stones him.
plates.file: The Death of Stephen (89485178).jpg

plates.title: Conversion of Saul
plates.scene: Near Damascus a light from heaven strikes Saul to the ground, and his armed companions fall and cower around him as the voice of Jesus asks why he persecutes him.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89485292).jpg

plates.title: Peter in the House of Cornelius
plates.scene: In Caesarea, Peter speaks to Cornelius's gathered household and friends, telling them God has shown him to call no one common or unclean.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89485361).jpg

plates.title: Peter Delivered From Prison
plates.scene: An angel fills Herod's prison with light, loosens Peter's chains, and leads him out past the guards.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89485423).jpg

plates.title: Paul Preaching to the Thessalonians
plates.scene: At Thessalonica, Paul stands and reasons from the Scriptures before the elders seated in the synagogue, proclaiming that Jesus is the Christ.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89485452).jpg

plates.title: Paul at Ephesus
plates.scene: While Paul preaches in Ephesus, new believers who had practiced magic bring their books and burn them in front of everyone.
plates.file: Paul in Ephesus (89485605).jpg

plates.title: Paul Rescued From the Multitude
plates.scene: Roman soldiers pull Paul away from the furious crowd at the temple and carry him up the stairs toward the fortress while the people shout 'Away with him'.
plates.file: Paul Addresses the Crowd After His Arrest (89485728).jpg

plates.title: Paul Shipwrecked
plates.scene: The ship carrying Paul runs aground and breaks up in the surf, and everyone aboard struggles through the waves, swimming or on planks, to reach the shore safely.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89485783).jpg

plates.title: John at Patmos
plates.scene: Exiled on Patmos, John sits on a rock by the sea holding a tablet and looks up toward the light as he is told to write what he sees.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89485903).jpg

plates.title: The Vision of Death
plates.scene: When the fourth seal is opened, Death rides out on a pale horse with Hell following him.
plates.file: Gustave Dore - Death on the Pale Horse.png

plates.title: The Woman Clothed with the Sun: A Vision of John
plates.scene: A great wonder in heaven: the woman clothed with the sun, crowned with stars, stands upon the moon amid the heavenly host, while armed angels descend against the great dragon coiling below. Doré titled the plate “The Crowned Virgin” and, following Marian imagery, shows her holding her child, whom John sees born and caught up to God (12:2–5).
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89486085).jpg

plates.title: Babylon Fallen
plates.scene: Fallen Babylon lies in moonlit ruins, its great statues and colonnades deserted and haunted by birds and wild beasts.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89486816).jpg

plates.title: The Last Judgment
plates.scene: Heaven blazes with the glory of the great white throne and ranks of angels, as the dead are judged and angels drive the condemned down into the abyss.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89486421).jpg

plates.title: The New Jerusalem
plates.scene: From a high mountain an angel shows John the holy city, the new Jerusalem, shining with the glory of God as light streams down from heaven.
plates.file: Pismo Swiete Starego i Nowego Testamentu. T. 2 1874 (89486509).jpg
